class.name: CaveVoxelGenerator
class.brief_description: A generator producing connected tunnel-like caves from noise.
class.description: CaveVoxelGenerator carves tunnels where three independent noise fields are all near zero at once. A continuous function from 4D space to 3D values is typically zero on a connected set of dimension 1, so the caves form connected, winding tunnels whose typical diameter along the horizontal axes is [member diameter]. Inside the tunnels is [member cave_material], air by default; outside is [member outer_material], undefined by default, so that lower layers of a [LayeredVoxelGenerator] show through there.

members.member: The material filling the tunnels, [code]254[/code] for air by default.
The typical diameter of the tunnels along the horizontal axes, in voxels. Individual tunnels vary around it, pinching and widening.
The scale of the finest octave's noise along the three horizontal axes, in voxels. Larger scales make the tunnels wind more gently.
The main parameter determining cave spacing. It sets the number of noise layers in each field, each at twice the scale of the previous.
The material outside the tunnels, or [code]255[/code] (the default) to leave it undefined.
The factor between the amplitudes of consecutive octaves: each finer octave's amplitude is the previous amplitude times this. Affects cave smoothness and spacing.
The vertical (Y) scale of the finest octave's noise, in voxels. The tunnels' vertical extent scales with it relative to [member horizontal_scale].
